poster.purpose: The one word on an opening, problem, solution, demand or closing slide; rises letter by letter.

headline.purpose: One line per data slide, shrunk to fit; rises letter by letter on entry.

figure.purpose: Key numbers; digits roll into place.

technical.purpose: Timecodes, call IDs, track names, units, arrow labels, slide numbers.

shadows.name: lit
shadows.purpose: Placet's chart mark and the playhead only.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.value: 900px: presenter buttons hide, the tape centres

components.name: Segment switch
components.description: Chart switch; a silver knob springs to the selected option.

components.name: Yes key
components.description: The lit key that marks the caller's yes on posters.

components.name: Section cues
components.description: Top-rail sections; the current one carries a glowing sky underline.

narrative.northStar: A call recording you can play, at night
narrative.overview: Every slide is dark and sits on Placet's two-track format: silver agent track above a centre line, sky-blue customer track below, and a lit playhead that records each slide in.
keyCharacteristics: Scrubbable live waveform posters with a slow aurora
Letter-by-letter headline reveals and rolling digit counters
One lit sky element per view

rules.name: The record light rule
rules.body: Sky appears on the one thing the presenter is pointing at.

rules.name: Context is slate, losses are red
rules.body: Chart context uses slate; losses use soft red below the zero line.

rules.name: No eyebrows
rules.body: Page labels live in the running foot, never above a heading.

dos: Keep one lit thing per view
Keep a legend for two-series charts
Keep poster effects to gradients and transforms
